method: Compare with DESI VI Table 2 and with the priors recorded in the public chains (.updated.yaml); report the largest w0 + wa reached by the posterior samples.
text: DESI VI uses uniform priors w0 in [-3, 1] and wa in [-3, 2] with the condition w0 + wa < 0; the data go nowhere near the last condition.
rests_on: C9's prior reweighting is relative to exactly this prior.
